title: Fuzzy Logic Controller
text: Evaluate fuzzy inference system, 1 input, 5 outputs, {Data type} sets Signal data type; {FIS name} sets the fuzzy inference system to evaluate mamfis, {Design}, {Number of samples for output discretization} sets the number of points in output fuzzy sets, {Implement FIS as lookup table} sets the convert FIS to lookup table, {Number of input breakpoints (samples)} sets the number of lookup table breakpoints, {Fuzzified inputs (fi)} enables fi output port, {Rule firing strengths (rfs)} enables rfs output port, {Rule outputs (ro)} enables ro output port, {Aggregated outputs (ao)} enables ao output port, {Simulate using} sets the simulation mode Interpreted, {Out of range input value} sets the diagnostic message behavior when an input is out of range, {No rule fired} sets the diagnostic message behavior when no rules fire and {Empty output fuzzy set} sets the diagnostic message behavior when an output fuzzy set is empty. Values come from the instance.

params.name: FIS name
params.values: Fuzzy inference system to evaluate mamfis object | sugfis object | mamfistype2 object | sugfistype2 object | FIS file name in quotes | MAT file name in quotes

params.name: Number of samples for output discretization
params.values: Number of points in output fuzzy sets 101 (default) | integer greater than 1

params.name: Data type
params.values: Signal data type double (default) | single | fixed-point | expression

params.name: Implement FIS as lookup table
params.values: Convert FIS to lookup table off (default) | on

params.name: Number of input breakpoints (samples)
params.values: Number of lookup table breakpoints 10 (default) | positive integer

params.name: Fuzzified inputs (fi)
params.values: Enable fi output port off (default) | on

params.name: Rule firing strengths (rfs)
params.values: Enable rfs output port off (default) | on

params.name: Rule outputs (ro)
params.values: Enable ro output port off (default) | on

params.name: Aggregated outputs (ao)
params.values: Enable ao output port off (default) | on

params.name: Simulate using
params.values: Simulation mode Interpreted execution (default) | Code generation

params.name: Out of range input value
params.values: Diagnostic message behavior when an input is out of range warning (default) | error | none

params.name: No rule fired
params.values: Diagnostic message behavior when no rules fire warning (default) | error | none

params.name: Empty output fuzzy set
params.values: Diagnostic message behavior when an output fuzzy set is empty warning (default) | error | none
